prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 678px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 677px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者根据 API 错误码和错误信息定位原因，并查找对应的解决办法。","reading":"读者通常先扫描首列错误码或次列错误信息，找到对应行后横向阅读含义和解决办法；行内文字换行应保持各行之间清晰可辨。","groups":["错误码与错误信息共同用于识别问题，应便于快速扫描并保持标识完整。","含义与解决办法共同用于排查：前者解释原因，后者指导操作，均可自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["五位数字错误码","INVALID_CREDENTIAL 等错误信息标识","AppID、access_token、AppSecret、OpenID 等技术标识"],"may_wrap":["含义中的中文解释可在自然语义处换行。","解决办法中的说明可换行；较长的解决办法形成的行高也可容纳同一行含义的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [70, 175, 170, 262] · table 678×1500px · row heights [36, 199, 222, 199, 199, 222, 199, 222] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [70, 175, 116, 316] · table 678×1384px · row heights [36, 222, 176, 199, 176, 199, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [70, 175, 240, 192] · table 678×2012px · row heights [36, 269, 315, 269, 269, 292, 269, 292] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"错误码和错误信息完整且易于纵向扫描；含义列有足够的行宽，解决办法也能保持技术标识完整。各行边界清楚，适合横向查阅。","problems":"解决办法仍较窄，长说明形成密集的八九行文字；含义列在多数行结束得较早，留下较多空白。","cause":"含义列为170px，解决办法列为262px；前者获得的宽度相对于其内容量偏多，后者则承担了大部分行高。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"识别列保持完整，316px的解决办法列让操作说明更易连续阅读，整体行高也较均衡。","problems":"含义列过窄，中文短语频繁跨行，部分单元格比解决办法更高；首行尤其明显，削弱了原因与操作之间的阅读节奏。","cause":"含义列只有116px，扣除内边距和边框后仅剩95px文本宽度，虽能容纳最长技术标识，但中文每行可容纳的字数很少。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"含义列宽敞，原因解释易读；错误码和错误信息仍完整，行分隔也清楚。","problems":"解决办法被挤成长而窄的文字块，频繁换行使表格显著变长；其他列在高行中留下大片空白，跨行对应关系更难追踪。","cause":"含义列占240px，而内容最多的解决办法列只有192px，宽度分配与两列的文字量不成比例。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[70,175,140,292],"change":"在r0A与r0B之间折中：将含义列由170px收至140px，把30px交给解决办法。保留技术标识所需宽度，同时减轻两列各自的密集换行。"},{"name":"action-first","widths":[70,175,130,302],"change":"以r0B为基础，将14px从解决办法移给含义列，缓解原因解释的短行，同时保留较宽的操作说明列，检验两列行高能否更接近。"},{"name":"meaning-first","widths":[70,175,155,277],"change":"保留较舒展的含义列，并比r0A多给解决办法15px；适合优先保证原因解释可读性的排查场景。"}]}
